Condition: Aras session active and Library query succeeds
Data behavior: Load live Part CAD and revision metadata

Condition: User has no accessible Library
Data behavior: Show onboarding instead of empty table

Condition: Selected Library has zero entries
Data behavior: Keep Library selection and filters visible

Condition: Search refresh or revision resolution in progress
Data behavior: Retain previous results to avoid layout shift

Condition: Aras request fails or session expires
Data behavior: Allow cached browsing only when available

Condition: User can get Library but lacks contributor permission
Visible message: You can view but cannot modify
Primary action: Open or reuse if Part permissions allow
Data behavior: Do not hide commands; show disabled reason tooltip

Condition: Same Library plus Part config plus revision policy exists
Visible message: HANDLE already exists in this Library
Data behavior: Select existing relationship

Condition: Selected PDM node has no Aras Part ID
Visible message: Push the Part to Aras before saving
Data behavior: Do not create Library relationship to local-only node

Condition: Part exists but no linked native CAD
Data behavior: Allow Part reference when category policy permits

Condition: CAD is locked by another Identity
Data behavior: Reuse BOM remains allowed

Condition: Resolved current revision differs from latest released
Data behavior: Show impact and Where Used

Condition: Entry or Part is deprecated or obsolete
Visible message: Do not use in new designs
Data behavior: Preserve audit and Where Used

Condition: No active PDM workspace
Visible message: Open or clone a PDM Project
Data behavior: Library browsing remains enabled

Condition: Active branch is not main
Data behavior: Commit reference locally

Condition: Current workspace snapshot differs from last commit
Data behavior: Merge new Library reference into current changes

Condition: Selected parent would produce a recursive structure
Data behavior: Do not write library-references.json

Condition: Parent already contains resolved Part
Visible message: Part already exists under selected parent
Data behavior: Edit existing Part BOM quantity

Condition: User can see Library entry but cannot get related Part
Visible message: You do not have permission to read this Part
Data behavior: Do not leak restricted Part metadata

Condition: User can read Part CAD but cannot download File
Data behavior: Allow metadata and BOM reuse if permitted

Condition: Standard Library entry is waiting for reviewer
Data behavior: Display reviewer and submitted comment

Condition: Reviewer requests rework
